updates.title: The First Private Spacesuit
updates.subtitle: Axiom Space — with an assist from Prada — is building the next-generation lunar suit. Here's what makes it different.
updates.summary: For the first time, NASA astronauts on the Moon will wear a spacesuit built by a private company. A look inside the AxEMU.
updates.author: Joachim Gresslien

updates.title: Artemis III's Most Improbable Maneuver
updates.subtitle: A fleet of Starship tankers. Cryogenic propellant transfer in orbit. An engineering challenge that has never been attempted — and could derail NASA's entire Moon plan.
updates.summary: Before humans can return to the Moon, SpaceX has to solve an orbital refueling problem no one has ever attempted. Here's why experts are worried.
updates.author: Joachim Gresslien

updates.title: What Artemis II Taught Us
updates.subtitle: Thermal performance, communications, heat shield behavior — here's what engineers discovered in the post-flight data review.
updates.summary: The data is in from humanity's first crewed mission beyond LEO in over 50 years. Six things engineers have learned so far.
updates.author: Joachim Gresslien

updates.title: Artemis II: The Complete Mission Recap
updates.subtitle: Ten days that changed human spaceflight — from launch to splashdown in pictures and video
updates.summary: A visual retrospective of the 10-day mission that took humans farther from Earth than anyone since Apollo 17. With NASA's official mission recap video.
updates.author: Joachim Gresslien
